observations: Photo shows a Nikon DSLR camera body on a table.
Two lenses are visible: one looks like a zoom lens (appears similar to 18-55mm style) and another looks like a prime lens (appears similar to 50mm style).
No Canon branding is visible in the photo.
No model number/label is clearly readable on the camera body or lenses.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows two lenses, but the exact focal lengths (18-55mm and 50mm) are not readable.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show sensor condition, shutter count, autofocus performance, or video functionality.
Photo 0 shows a Nikon camera body (Nikon text visible), not Canon.

risks.risk: Brand mismatch / wrong listing: seller says Canon but photos show Nikon; could be a different system or bait-and-switch.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the camera model name/number on the body (e.g., on the front/top) and lens markings showing focal length (18-55 and 50).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a Nikon DSLR kit with unknown exact models and assume average condition; do not price as Canon.

risks.risk: Exact lens focal lengths may not be 18-55mm and 50mm (could be different ranges or third-party lenses).
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of both lenses’ front ring/label showing focal length and mount compatibility.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic 2-lens Nikon DSLR kit (worst-case: lenses not confirmed to be the stated focal lengths).

risks.risk: Functional condition unknown (shutter, autofocus, lens focus, video output, buttons/ports).
risks.proof: Request a short video clip showing live view autofocus and recording, plus a photo of the rear screen showing menu/settings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working/untested; treat as worst-case until tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card, straps, caps) can materially change value.
risks.proof: Ask for a full contents photo laid out: battery, charger, both lens caps, body cap (if any), strap, USB/AV cables, and memory card.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal accessories (battery/charger not guaranteed).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the camera model name/number on the body (not just the brand).
Send close-up photos of both lenses showing the exact focal length markings (18-55 and 50) and whether they are original/third-party.
Send a short test video (live view + autofocus + recording) to confirm video works.
Send a photo of everything included (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card).
response.reason: The photo contradicts the seller’s Canon claim (it shows Nikon), and the exact lens focal lengths and functionality are not verifiable from the single image. Proof is needed before a reliable price.
